text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~!
This is way more of a deserted island than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The training facility looks pretty intense, too?
...Hehe, now I'm getting excited!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Oh, another new tester is here today!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Working hard to recruit
testers together really paid off~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We even got to hand out flyers in all sorts of places!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I believe I had them put up a poster
recruiting testers at my part-time job, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
City-chan even talked about
Tracen Island on the radio~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, things have gotten lively like this
and we're making progress on polishing it up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Island is really
getting better and better, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right. I feel like I can hold my head up high
and take on today's Tracen Island review meeting♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, was the evaluation meeting today!?
Shoot, I completely forgot!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone!
Time to gather in the meeting room~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, speak of the devil.
Shall we go, Ryan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the 3rd Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting began!
